properties.displayName: UAV S7 - EO/IR Downlink Interception and Frame Injection
properties.description: UAVImagery_CL의 EO/IR 영상 다운링크에서 프레임 무결성 검증 실패(FrameHashValid=false), 동일 StreamId 내 SessionId가 짧은 시간에 복수로 전환(세션 하이재킹), 또는 프레임 출발지(FrameSourceIP)가 스트림의 기대 출발지(ExpectedSourceIP)와 불일치하는 정황을 탐지. 감청 후 중계·재주입(MITM relay) 공격 패턴. MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK: T1557 Adversary-in-the-Middle (Collection/영상 감청·프레임 주입)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
UAVImagery_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| extend isBadHash = FrameHashValid == false
| extend isSourceMismatch = isnotempty(ExpectedSourceIP) and FrameSourceIP != ExpectedSourceIP
| where isBadHash or isSourceMismatch
| summarize
    BadHashCount = countif(isBadHash),
    SourceMismatchCount = countif(isSourceMismatch),
    DistinctSessions = dcount(SessionId),
    DistinctSourceIPs = dcount(FrameSourceIP),
    SampleFrameSeq = max(FrameSeq)
    by UAVId, StreamId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where BadHashCount > 0 or SourceMismatchCount > 0 or DistinctSessions > 1
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    BadHashCount > 0, strcat('영상프레임_무결성검증실패_', tostring(BadHashCount), '건'),
    DistinctSessions > 1, strcat('영상세션_하이재킹_의심_세션', tostring(DistinctSessions), '개'),
    strcat('영상프레임_출발지불일치_', tostring(SourceMismatchCount), '건'))
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, StreamId, BadHashCount, SourceMismatchCount, DistinctSessions, DistinctSourceIPs, SampleFrameSeq, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S7 - EO/IR Downlink Interception and Frame Injection - {{UAVId}}
